items.title: File Einspruch against the 2024 income tax assessment
items.quote: Die Einspruchsfrist beträgt einen Monat und beginnt mit Ablauf des Tages, an dem der Bescheid bekannt gegeben wurde; wird er Ihnen per Post zugeschickt, gilt er nach § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben, falls er Sie nicht nachweislich erst später oder gar nicht erreicht hat.
items.computation: The letter itself states the actual posting date: 'Zur Post gegeben am 14.05.2025' (Wednesday), two days after the letter's own date (12.05.2025). Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO the notice is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting: 14.05.2025 + 4 days = Sunday 18.05.2025. Since that day is a non-working day, tax-law practice (AEAO zu § 108 Nr. 2, § 108 Abs. 3 AO) moves the deemed-delivery day to the next working day, Monday 19.05.2025. The one-month Einspruch period then runs under § 108 Abs. 1 AO / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB starting the day after deemed delivery, ending under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB one month later on the same-numbered day: Thursday 19.06.2025. That day is Fronleichnam, a public holiday in Saarland, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline shifts to the next working day, Friday 20.06.2025.

warnings: The letter's own date (12.05.2025, a Monday) and its stated posting date ('Zur Post gegeben am 14.05.2025', a Wednesday) are two days apart; the Einspruch deadline above is calculated from the stated posting date, which German tax law treats as the authoritative anchor for the delivery fiction — double-check this printed posting date if you have any doubt.

Verify the payee IBAN (DE37 5905 0000 0008 8120 01, Saarländische Musterbank) against a previous, trusted communication from Finanzamt Beispielbrück before paying, as a general precaution — it is a validly formed German IBAN but that alone does not confirm who holds the account.
